# orchestration_cluster_mapping_rule (Resource)

A mapping rule inside a Camunda cluster. See the Camunda documentation on [mapping rules](https://docs.camunda.io/docs/components/admin/mapping-rules/).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "orchestration_cluster_mapping_rule" "admin" {
  mapping_rule_id = "admin-mapping"
  claim_name      = "groups"
  claim_value     = "admin"
  name            = "Admin Mapping"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `claim_name` (String) The name of the claim to map.
- `claim_value` (String) The value of the claim to map.
- `mapping_rule_id` (String) The unique ID for the mapping rule.
- `name` (String) The name of the mapping rule.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import orchestration_cluster_mapping_rule.admin "admin-mapping"
```
